annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of Management and Budget (OMB), Executive Office of the President
key_provisions_or_claims: Agencies must avoid regulatory or non-regulatory actions that needlessly hamper AI innovation and growth, and avoid precautionary approaches.
Ten stewardship principles including public trust, public participation, scientific integrity, risk assessment, fairness, transparency, safety and security.
Use risk-based, tiered, performance-based and flexible approaches rather than rigid design-based rules.
Prefer non-regulatory approaches: sector guidance, pilot programs and safe harbors, voluntary consensus standards.
Agencies must submit plans to OMB on consistency with the memo, 180 days after issuance.
annotation.summary_en: Draft OMB memorandum implementing Executive Order 13859, guiding US federal agencies on regulating private-sector AI applications. It urges light-touch, risk-based, innovation-friendly approaches, ten stewardship principles, preference for non-regulatory measures and voluntary consensus standards, and agency plans on regulatory barriers. It has no robot-specific provisions.
annotation.title_clean: Draft Memorandum: Guidance for Regulation of Artificial Intelligence Applications
